title: Provincial Small Cause Courts Sindh Amendment Act 1932

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Small Cause Courts Sindh Amendment Act 1932
sections.description:
Short title

[THE PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSE COURTS (SIND AMENDMENT)
[THE PROVINCIAL
SMALL CAUSE COURTS (SIND AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1932]
SIND ACT No. IX OF
1932*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B. G. G., 1931, Pt. V, pp. 243-2445 and for
proceedings in Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1931, Vol. XXXII,
1932, Vol. XXXV.]]
[10th
November, 1932]
An Act further to
amend the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887, in its application to the *[Province of Sind.]
1. Short title. This Act
may be called the Provincial Small Cause Court (**[Sind]
Amendment) Act, 1932.
*[Subs. by the Sind Laws (Adaptation
Revision, Repeal and Declaration) Ordinance, 1955 (Sind 5 of 1955), s. 3 (ii)
(a) (w. e. f. 30th May 1951) for Presidency of Bombay".]
**[Subs. ibid, s. 3 (i), for
'Bombay".]

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Small Cause Courts Sindh Amendment Act 1932
sections.description:
Amendment of the second schedule to Act IX of 1887

[THE PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSE COURTS (SIND AMENDMENT)
[THE PROVINCIAL
SMALL CAUSE COURTS (SIND AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1932]
SIND ACT No. IX OF
1932*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B. G. G., 1931, Pt. V, pp. 243-2445 and for
proceedings in Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1931, Vol. XXXII,
1932, Vol. XXXV.]]
[10th
November, 1932]
An Act further to
amend the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887, in its application to the *[Province of Sind.]
2. Amendment of the second
schedule to Act IX of 1887.---In sub-clause (a) of clause 4 in the Second
Schedule to the said Act, between the words " a written instrument "
and " and" the following words shall be inserted, namely :-
" or orally ".
